_notes: Paths are relative to the extracted pack folder: office -> assets-src/downloads/furniture-kit, food -> assets-src/downloads/food-kit, character -> assets-src/downloads/blocky-characters, sfx -> assets-src/downloads/impact-sounds.

Furniture Kit 2.0 ships its glTF binaries in 'Models/GLTF format' (no Textures folder there; materials are plain colours). Food Kit 2.0 and Blocky Characters 2.0 use 'Models/GLB format' with a sibling Textures folder.
fridge: no 'fridge.glb'; substituted kitchenFridge.glb (standard free-standing kitchen fridge; Small/Large/BuiltIn variants also exist).
pantryCounter: no counter model by that name; substituted kitchenCabinet.glb (counter-height base cabinet with worktop). kitchenBar.glb is the alternative.
plantSmall: no 'plantSmall.glb'; substituted plantSmall1.glb (plantSmall2/3 also exist).
cupCoffee: Food Kit file name is cup-coffee.glb (kebab case).
drop-wood-1: impactWood has heavy/medium/light variants; drop-wood-0 uses heavy_000 and drop-wood-1 uses medium_000 for audible variety.
drop-soft-0 and drop-metal-0 use the heavy_000 variant; Impact Sounds 1.0 has no un-suffixed impactSoft/impactMetal files.
